bayts.text: just as You made him the gladness of the righteous, and his light leads them at every moment.
O Allah, O Last (Al-Ākhir), You are the First (Al-Awwal), O You through Whom Rabīʿ al-Awwal becomes clear,
bless with a blessing that never ceases to be clear, arriving to the Prophet with well-being,
with a peace that no turbidity clouds, O You through Whom the Decree runs, by His leave,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
just as You made him the illuminer of the masters, the chosen, the God-fearing, the leaders.
And bless him perpetually with peace, with all the noble party, O Peace.
O You Who lead to me the Remembrance like the Mathānī (Qurʾān 15:87), O You through Whom Rabīʿ ath-Thānī has been good,
bless with a blessing that never ceases to watch every enemy aiming at the Gardens,
with a peace that drives off every envier, as the Companions, possessed of light, the lions, drove off.
upon the Prophet of Allah, the sword of Allah, our master, the Light, the Messenger of Allah,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
just as You made him the patron of the God-fearing, in secret and in public, the enemy of the wretched.
And through him You made me beloved of the Muslims, just as toward others than me You turned the criminals.
O You Who granted me a guidance that shows (the way), O You through Whom Jumādā al-Ūlā has been good,
bless with a blessing that never ceases to ascend, growing, accepted and lasting,
with a peace that brings the best of good into the heart of the master of creation, and it enters,
upon him whom I have loved, O my Lord, just as through it You made him an arbiter for me.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And efface forever the turning of harm toward me, by his standing, O You through whom You have been worshipped.
And make my rank with You the finest, and with You make me the most radiant servant.
And efface the turning of harm toward my body, and do not turn my enviers toward my directions.
O You Who protected me from the toil of the fleeting (world), and for me make Jumādā ath-Thāniya good,
bless with a blessing that makes glad tidings everlasting for me, glad tidings for the Chosen, the best of mankind,
with a peace that drives what is unfitting toward other than him who is worthy of my eulogy.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my praises of him and the blessings above all acts of worship and supplications.
And make me free, through them, of seeking means, O You Who protected me from enemies and ruin.
And bear witness for me, forever, that I am a believer, a Muslim and a doer of good, and that I persevere.
O You Who lead to me, from the chief of the sacred months — our intimate, our beloved Muḥarram —
what gladdens my heart, beneficial and perpetual, O You to Whom (goes) from me the praise of Aḥmad,
bless with a blessing and endless peace him who led to me what is desired,
in the present and the final outcome — and he is the support —, who drove toward others than me those who charged (me) with dotage.
O You Who lead to me, without earning or travel, what puts earning and weapons to shame, in Ṣafar,
bless with a blessing accompanied by peace and by growing, exalted blessings,
upon the Prophet of Allah, the joy of men and the adornment of women, who effaced the field (of the enemies).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who lead to me what effaced false attribution, and led to me from You Rabīʿ al-Awwal,
bless with a complete blessing and peace, and with ascending, perfect blessings,
upon the son of ʿAbd Allāh, servant of Allah, leader of Allah's creatures to God.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who lead to me the Remembrance and the Mathānī, and led to me from You Rabīʿ ath-Thānī,
bless with a blessing no blessing equals the Prophet of Allah, a lion against the haters,
with a peace no peace equals; and give glad tidings of me to the possessor of comprehensive words.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
O You Who lead to me, out of generosity, magnification, and led to me from You Jumādā al-Ūlā,
bless with a blessing that drives enemies toward a direction other than mine and effaces illness,
with a peace that unveils secrets to me forever and sends the wicked away
toward others than me and others than my household, and sends rulers away like the princes
toward others than me, (away) from my direction, without meeting and without cajoling the wretched,
upon the Prophet and Messenger, the banner, who leads to me the knowledge of what we did not know.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
